title: PolicyDecision
description: Binding contract for the structured decision returned by the shox semantic policy gate (wrapped /v1/chat call) to webi3-website. See PHASE_1.md section 2.4.

decision.description: The policy taxonomy outcome. Fixed, closed set for Phase 1.

reason_code.description: Short machine-readable category explaining the decision. Must be one of the fixed vocabulary values below.

explanation.description: Optional, human-readable, truncated explanation for audit/support review. Never shown to end users as the sole moderation message.

model.description: The resolved model id from shox that produced this decision (for provenance).

policy_version.description: Version of the policy taxonomy/system prompt that produced this decision. See policy/policy-version.md.
